post.text:
Two of the three measles deaths in 2025 were previously healthy, unvaccinated school-aged children. 

The third was an immunocompromised adult who couldn’t safely receive the live vaccine and was relying on the rest of us to protect him. Measles killed healthy kids this year. The https://t.co/jnJNn9Mjo9
